description: Translate a SQL query into a pandas transform module plus a parity test that runs on your sample. When moving a query out of a warehouse into dataframe code. Do not choose this when the query uses joins, CTEs or window functions. Example requests: Convert this SQL query to pandas. | Migrate this query to a dataframe transform. | Give me the pandas equivalent of this SQL.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

sample.description: The customer's sample.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row. A sample of the source rows. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

sql.description: The customer's query.sql, as text. Supported: SQL text. The query to translate. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_sql_to_dataframe_migration
title: SQL to dataframe migration
